polymorph:
Polymorph is a mod that solves recipe conflicts by letting players choose between all potential
outputs shared by the same ingredients.

With a sufficiently large amount of mods, recipe conflicts are a common occurrence and the
responsibility for resolving these usually falls on the user or modpack developer, using datapacks
or other tools to ensure that each recipe is unique.

Polymorph offers an alternative solution, allowing all possible crafting and smelting recipes to
co-exist regardless of conflicts.

 Features

 Crafting

 

When a group of ingredients matches more than one recipe, a button will appear above the output
slot. Pushing this button will show a list of all possible results and selecting one will change the
crafting output to match. Polymorph will also remember the last selection as long as the ingredients
don't change, so repeated crafting actions are possible on the s

Wabi-Sabi Structures adds a plethora of new structures that generate throughout your Minecraft world, all designed with the Japanese philosophy of "Wabi-Sabi" in mind - embracing imperfection while still being aesthetically interesting.

Our structures uniquely complement Minecraft's generation with little extra spices. Expect anything from patches of natural crops, to various cozy cabins, degraded stables, dangerous towers, ominous monoliths, underground eggs of mysterious creatures, and more. Our aim is to provide newfound excitement in exploring new terrain, in a way that allows each world, biome, and dimension to have enhanced variety.

 

 Features

Description 
 Simple Login is a lightweight and secure authentication plugin/mod designed for Minecraft servers, supporting versions 1.17–26.x. It provides a login and registration system where players must register using /register and log in using /login before interacting with the server. Until authentication is completed, players are restricted from moving, interacting with their inventory, breaking or placing blocks, and performing other gameplay actions, ensuring protection against unauthorized access.

Cooldown Coordinator
Fabric library to help mods coordinate item movement cooldowns

 What it Does
Cooldown Coordinator is a library mod intended to enable heterogeneous networks of vanilla hoppers and item transferring modded block entities to move items throughout the network in a vanilla-alike and consistent manner. For example, one goal is to allow sorters consisting of a mixture of vanilla and modded hoppers, ducts, etc. to behave predictably.

 How Does it Do it?
The mod provides an interface to implement and a method to call when a cooldown should be triggered. The method may safely be called with any BlockEntity as its argument. When the target BE implements the interface, it will be notified of the cooldown and can take whatever action it deems appropriate. dimension-leak-fix:
Every time you change dimension or go back to the menu, the game leaves the old world behind and Java is supposed to free it. If any mod still holds a reference to that world (a static field, a cache keyed by world), the whole world stays in RAM: its chunks, its entities and, in singleplayer, the whole stopped server with its recipes, loot tables and advancements. A few dimension changes or a few world reloads later, memory is full.

 Dimension Leak Fix empties what the game has abandoned, so whatever still holds it only holds an empty shell, and makes known leaky mods let go of it.

 What it does

 Dimension change or return to menu: 3 seconds later, the old world's chunk slots are released and the maps and lists it owns are emptied, including the ones other mods add to it. Once its connection is closed, the client copy of the recipes and the old player's recipe book are emptied too.

- Freezing: Melee, 3 Levels, freezes(slows) mobs
- Guarding Strike: Melee, 3 Levels, gives damage resistance after defeating a mob
- Illager's Bane: Melee, 3 Levels, does extra damage to illagers
- Leeching: Melee, 3 Levels, leeches percentage of mob's max health after defeating a mob
- Pain Cycle: Melee, 3 Levels, damages the player and when it stacks 5 times does a lot of damage to mob and resets stack
- Ambush: Melee, 3 Levels, does extra damage to unsuspecting entities (when they are not looking in your general direction)
- Exploding: Melee, 3 Levels, creates explosion on attack
- Radiance: Melee, 3 Levels, heals nearby players

Memory Allocation
Some classes can be very memory dense, they have a big memory footprint.
This is an issue because your computer can only fit 64 bytes into a processor's cache line, so anything over 64 needs to be split into multiple lines. This can drastically slow down operations based on what is being called.
So obviously the best solution is to make sure nothing is over 64 bytes, this is a lot easier said than done, since there's multiple downsides to this, although they don't matter in the circumstances that ive optimized.

Chunk Memory Allocation
Chunks are very memory dense and take up 80 bytes. Using some hacky fabric-ASM we are able to nuke variables from the Chunk class and redirect all the calls.
This allows us to bring the chunk back down to 64, which on some computers can make most chunk operations 0.25x faster!

SQLite JDBC for Minecraft

A maintained fork of the dormant SQLite JDBC for Minecraft mod, now tracking the latest Xerial sqlite-jdbc release with auto-bumps whenever upstream cuts a new version.

The mod does nothing on its own — it ships the SQLite JDBC driver onto the server's classpath so other plugins/mods that want to read or write .db / .sqlite files via JDBC don't each have to bundle their own copy.

Typical consumers: Dynmap, Plan, LuckPerms, Grim Anti-Cheat, and any plugin that wants embedded SQLite without redistributing 10MB of native binaries themselves.

 What's in the jar

 org.xerial:sqlite-jdbc:3.53.0.0 plus minimal loader stubs for Spigot, Forge 1.12, Forge 1.13–1.16, Forge 1.17–1.20, NeoForge 1.21+, and Fabric. The driver classes stay at their canonical org.sqlite. paths — no relocation — so consumers find them with plain Class.forName("org.sqlite.JDBC") . META-INF/ser

Basically grows the vanilla threadcount/list sizes for everything that could make chunk compilation/rendering faster, as well as removing the limitations in those functions that could make the chunk loading stop in favor of other rendering elements

The mod name is technically a bit clickbaity, Minecraft's chunkloading is already multithreaded, except:
- In vanilla the threadcount is so low it basically doesn't do much
- When using Optifine (which you most likely should instead of this mod) it adapts the threadcount based on your available ressources, which is good except if you actually want to dedicate all of your ressources strictly to loading chunks

- Reduced FPS while chunks are loading, basically prioritizing their compilation over other stuff (tradeoff

show-my-maps:
See what a filled map shows without putting it in your hand. 

 

Vanilla only draws a map's picture while you hold it. Everywhere else it is a blank roll of parchment: in your inventory, in a chest, in an auction GUI, lying on the ground. This draws the real thing instead.

---

 What it does

 

- Map icons — the slot shows the art in place of the parchment sprite, so a page full of map art reads at a glance, with no hovering.
- Tooltip preview — hover a map anywhere a tooltip appears — inventory, chest, hopper, creative menu, a shop GUI — and the picture renders under the normal lines.
- Maps you never carried — a chest full of art reads as art, not as a row of identical parchment.
- Dropped maps spin as the art itself instead of a rolled parchment.
- Shulker box tooltip — hover a box and its contents appear as a slot grid, maps included, replacing vanilla's list of item names. Steps

voice-bridge-for-e4mc:
Simple Voice Chat doesn't work over e4mc on its own. e4mc tunnels the Minecraft connection, but Simple Voice Chat talks over a separate UDP port that the tunnel can't carry. This mod sends the voice packets through the Minecraft connection instead, so voice works in an e4mc world without forwarding port 24454.

Simple Voice Chat itself isn't changed. Proximity, groups, push-to-talk, voice activation and its encryption all work the same as on a normal server. It also works with Sound Physics Remastered, so voices still echo and muffle the way they would without the bridge.

 Installing

Host: Fabric API, Simple Voice Chat, e4mc (the Fabric Modern build) and this mod.

Everyone joining: Fabric API, Simple Voice Chat and this mod. They don't need e4mc.

Open your world to LAN, send your friends the address e4mc posts in chat, and have them join with it. There's nothing to configure.

What is this?
 World Guard is a mod that aims at preventing you from corrupting your world with awful chunk walls and missing biomes due to a changing seed or world generator or missing biomes.

 How does it work?
 Between world loads, World Guard locally saves basic information about your world's generator settings, dimensions, biomes installed mods, and installed datapacks. With this basic information stored, everytime the server starts, World Guard will run various checks including:
 World Seed is the exact same. (config= crash when mismatched seed=true )
 Chunk generator settings and type are the exact same. (config= crash when mismatched chunk generator=true )
 Ensuring no biomes have been removed from your server. (config= crash when removed biome=true )
 Ensuring no dimension were removed from your server. (config= crash when missing dimension=true )
 Ensuring the biome source use

nether-under-overworld:
Details: This datapack/server-side mod allows you to cross the bedrock barrier between the overworld and nether. Standing on bedrock at the bottom of the overworld will teleport you to the same x/z coordinates in the upper layers of the nether, and touching your head against the bedrock at the top of the nether will teleport you to the same x/z coordinates at the bottom of the overworld.

If you are in adventure or survival mode, the teleportation process will create an air pocket at your destination. If you are in creative or spectator mode, you will still teleport, but an air pocket won't be made so that the world isn't affected by operators or spectating players.

Spawning Overhaul

A Minecraft mod that creates a more immersive mob spawning system based on environmental factors like caves, forests, and structures.

 Features

 Environment-Based Spawning

Instead of mobs spawning uniformly everywhere, this mod makes spawning rates dependent on the spawn location's environment:

- Base Multiplier : Configure a global spawn rate that applies everywhere (default: 0.2x)
- Cave Spawning : Progressive scaling based on depth
 - Shallow caves (Y=60): Minimum multiplier (default: 1.0x = 20% acceptance)
 - Deep caves (Y=-64): Maximum multiplier (default: 5.0x = 100% acceptance)
 - The deeper you go, the more dangerous it gets!
- Forest Spawning : Progressive scaling based on tree density
 - Sparse areas: Minimum multiplier (default: 1.0x)
 - Dense forests/jungles: Maximum multiplier (default: 3.0x)
 - More trees = more danger
- Structure Spawning : Dangerous

This data pack offers an intuitive way for players to bury their own loot and create their own suspicious sand/gravel by simply placing sand or gravel on top of items.

 3 simple steps: 
1. Throw your item (can be multiple of the same item) onto the ground.
2. Place a sand or gravel block onto the same block that it falls on.

Sketchy Books lets you draw pixel-art sketches directly inside Books & Quills , turning them into true illustrated journals.

Before signing a book, players can freely doodle on its pages using a simple pixel-based drawing interface, allowing sketches, symbols, diagrams, or small drawings to be added alongside written text.

 How It Works

flash-carts:
Minecarts are arguably the best transport in Minecraft, but they can be better
 

 

 About

The primary goal of this mod is to make minecarts better without breaking your Redstone.

 New Minecart Physics

To make Minecarts faster, Flash Carts uses Minecrafts experimental physics. 
These experimental physics allow for a lot higher speeds, but do often break redstone contraptions.
Because of this, the mod only applies the new physics where you would benefit from the higher speeds.

By default, the new physics are applied to normal and TNT minecarts, but not to chest, furnace, or hopper minecarts.

 Smart Halting
Slowing down minecarts can become inconsistent pretty quickly with the speeds made possible by this mod.
To account for this, it also adds 'smart halting' which will intelligently stop a cart at the end of a line of
unpowered rails or at the top of a unpowered slope.

 

 Building

Minecarts可以说是Minecraft中最好的交通工具，但它们还可以更好 新矿车物理 为了使Minecarts更快，Flash Carts使用了Minecraft实验物理。 这些实验物理学允许更高的速度，但经常打破红石装置。 正因为如此，模组只适用于新的物理，你会受益于更高的速度。 默认情况下，新的物理学适用于普通和TNT矿车，但不适用于胸腔、熔炉或漏斗矿车。 智能停机 减速矿车可以成为不一致的速度相当快，使之成为可能的这个模组。 为了解决这个问题，它还添加了“智能停止”，它将智能地停止一辆车在一行 无动力轨道或无动力斜坡的顶部。 建筑 unpowered rails or at the top of a unpowered slope. When the player dies:

- It formats the coordinates clearly.

forceexitonshutdown:
ForceExitOnShutdown

Fix minecraft crash on shutdown due to watchdog killing non-daemon thread by adding System.exit(0)

Minecraft do not execute System.exit(0); on exit anymore, so all the mods that do not clean up non-daemon executors by themselves will prevent the minecraft from fully close. Then the watchdog will kill minecraft and generate a crash.

This mod is used to fix this problem, by adding force exit as older version (26.2-) did.

 Important
 
 This may cause problem, since I don't know why mojang eventually remove that exit code.
 
 USE AT YOUR OWN RISK!

Return by Death

A mod inspired by the "Return by Death" concept from Re:Zero. It replaces the standard death and respawn mechanics with a world rollback: upon death, the game state returns to the last saved checkpoint.

 How it works
The mod records the state of loaded chunks, entities, and players. When a rollback is triggered upon death or manually, the world state is rewound.

To prevent divergence from the original timeline, internal random number generator (RNG) logic is adjusted. 🛡️ ModGuard + Sentinel — Client Verification System
A server plugin + client mod security system that verifies legitimate clients and detects malicious modifications using a secure encrypted handshake — far more reliable than client-brand checks or simple mod name detection.

 
 
 

---

 📦 Components

 🔌 ModGuard — Server Plugin 
Sends encrypted challenges to connecting players, verifies responses, checks mod IDs against a blacklist, enforces a minimum Sentinel version, and optionally limits total installed mods. Supports cracked servers, Geyser/Floodgate auto-bypass, configurable kick messages, player whitelist, and persistent mod history.

 🧩 Sentinel — Client Mod 
Installed by the player on their Fabric client. Receives the server challenge, collects the full mod list via FabricLoader, encrypts and returns it. Zero configuration. Zero performance impact.

---

 ⚙️ How It Works

In-Game Mod Manager

In-Game Mod Manager is a client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that lets you search, inspect, and download compatible content from Modrinth without leaving the game.

Instead of tabbing out to a browser, opening Modrinth manually, downloading files, and moving them into the correct folder yourself, this mod brings that workflow directly into Minecraft through a clean in-game interface. The goal is simple: make installing Fabric content faster, easier, and safer, especially for players who want a lightweight and convenient mod management experience.

 What this mod does

With In-Game Mod Manager, you can:

- open an in-game mod browser with a keybind
- search Modrinth directly from inside Minecraft
- view project details before downloading
- find versions that match your current Minecraft version

ModernPSX Compatibility

A small client-side compatibility mod for the Modern PSX Shaders pack .

ModernPSX uses PS1-style vertex snapping, which can cause layered models and effects to separate, jitter or fight over the same depth. This mod gives related layers a shared snapping reference so they stay together without removing the vertex snapping itself.

It currently includes handling for things such as:

- Banners and other layered block entities
- Entity model layers
- Fresh Animations through EMF/ETF
- Armour, eyes, emissive textures and similar overlays
- Wakes water effects

The mod does nothing useful without ModernPSX and Iris. Other supported mods are detected automatically and are not required.

 Installation

Install it like a normal client-side mod alongside:

- ModernPSX 
- Iris 
- Any optionally supported mods, such as Wakes, EMF or ETF

noheadbreak:
No Head Break — Waterlogged Mob Heads
 Mob heads no longer break when touched by water — and they can be fully waterlogged.

 

By default, Minecraft destroys any mob head that comes into contact with water. With this mod installed, heads resist water completely — flowing or source water will never pop them off.

 

Heads also support full waterlogging. Place a head underwater and it fills with water automatically. You can also right-click any head with a water bucket to waterlog it manually, and use an empty bucket to remove the water — exactly like stairs or slabs.

 

This works with every type of head — vanilla skulls, player heads, and heads added by mods like Just Mob Heads or Just Player Heads. If a mod adds heads, this mod covers them.

Fabric API required
This mod requires Fabric API. It must be installed on both client and server.

Minecraft 26.1.2 → Fabric API 0.149.1+26.1.2

Enhanced Soul Speed
This mod enhances the effect of the vanilla soul speed enchantment. 

While walking normally, speed is unchanged.

While sprinting, speed is increased by 2-6x depending on the level of enchantment.

Soul Speed I is three times as fast as it's base enchantment, Soul Speed II is 5 times as fast, and Soul Speed III is 7 times as fast. 

 Enchantment Level Vanilla Max Speed Enhanced Max Speed 
 --------------------- ----------------------- ---------------------- 
 I 7.88 B/s 23.66 B/s 
 II 8.47 B/s 42.37 B/s 
 III 9.06 B/s 63.45 B/s 

All speed measurements are in Blocks per second. These measurements were captured using this Speedometer Mod

These changes increase the utility of the Soul Speed enchantment, allowing a player with Soul Speed III to travel faster than a player with an elytra.

A simple mod that adds tameable ducks to Minecraft.

 Ducks

- Ducks are neutral mobs (they will attack when provoked).
- Ducks can pick up items and hold on to them.
- Ducks will drop any item they are holding to pick up duckweed.
- Ducks can eat duckweed, sea grass, seeds, melon slices and berries.
- Ducks will drink potions if they pick them up.
- They can be tamed and bred with duckweed.
- Tamed ducks will fight for you.
- Ducks can be found near river biomes (on land or swimming).
- Ducks prefer to be swimming in the water.
- They drop feathers and duckweed when killed.

 Duckweed

- Duckweed is a block that can be used to tame and breed ducks.
- It can be found in river biomes and swamps.
- It can be placed on water and land.
- It can be bonemealed to grow.

 Credits

- Base duck model by mbanders.
- Sounds by D4XX, ermfilm & qubodup.

This mod's only purpose is to play the boowomp sound effect whenever you break a block with the wrong tool and do not get the drop from it. assets/boowomp/sounds/failed block harvest.ogg

assets/boowomp/lang/en us.json
 

with the entry:

 
{
 "boowomp.subtitle.failed block harvest": "Boowomp"
}

The recommended default Modpack for the AtriocSMP!

Contains mostly lightweight client site mods.

The most notable mods are Simple Voice Chat (allowing in-game voice chat), AppleSkin (which makes the hunger bar provide more information about saturation, and the food you're holding), Minecraft Emote (allowing emojis to be used from different Twitch Channels in the in-game chat), and Zoomify (which allows you to zoom in).

This modpack is pre-setup to use Atrioc's Twitch Channel for the emotes. The ASMP server should already be in the multiplayer server list.

The Modpack also includes some off-by-default mostly cosmetic mods that you can enable to make Minecraft look/play a little better.

This Modpack was created for users of the AtriocSMP (discord.gg/asmp). It is not required to play on the server, but it is recommended! If you aren’t a member of the server, you can feel free to use it

简体中文

你玩过或听过像《Cookie Clicker》或《Idle Slayer》这样的放置游戏吗？如果你玩过或听过，那么这个整合包将会让你眼前一亮——没错，这个整合包在MC里还原了放置游戏！

在这个整合包中，你在一个小空岛的树上开局，同时开始拥有一个转化桌、一个MK1收集器、一个基础能量EMC接口与一本炼金术秘卷。你可以把收集器放在EMC接口旁边以自动获取EMC，开局的木头与树叶也能提供一些初始EMC。在你收集到了100EMC后，你就可以在转化桌里面购买另一个MK1收集器，从而使你的EMC生产翻倍。到了后期，你甚至会获得加速火把、时间洪流怀表等可以加速EMC生产的物品。然而，即使如此，想要达到此整合包的结局——9.22E EMC也不是一件简单的事。毕竟，一个EMC接口只有6个面，这意味着一个EMC接口只能让6个收集器同时生产EMC。

This lightweight datapack alters world generation to let mountains grow all the way up to the absolute world build height limit of Y=320, revealing their true, uncapped beauty.

simple-origin-changer:
A very simple datapack to allow players to change their origin a configurable amount of times (default 1) within a certain period of time since joining (default 30 minutes).

To access their origin change, players must run /trigger origin-change .

Time players spend in the origin selection gui is not counted towards the time limit for changing their origin.

The time limit and maximum number of origin changes a player can have can be easily adjusted by changing the following scores:

 
 36000 is 30 minutes in ticks (30 60 20)
/scoreboard players set maxTime origin-change-timer 36000
 1 max change per person
/scoreboard players set maxChanges origin-change-used 1
 

For example, if you wanted to change the time limit to 45 minutes, and the maximum number of changes to 2, you'd run the following commands:

 
/scoreboard players set maxTime origin-change-timer 54000
/scoreboard players set

kosmolots-colored-subtitles:
Kosmolot's Colored Subtitles

Too many subtitles? This pack gives them meaningful colors so that the important ones stand out.

 Red: dangerous things you should pay attention to.
 Dark red: ambient sounds of dangerous things.
 Yellow: unusual, potentially dangerous events like raid horns or lightning strikes.
 Gold: expected timed events like fishing splashes, brewing stand bubbling, zombie villager converting.
 Green: unusual, safe events like the wandering traders' hmm's.
 Dark green: ambient sounds of safe things, like animals.
 Blue: water-related ambient sounds.
 Dark gray: things that you can ignore, like footsteps or bats.

 Bugs? Suggestions?

If you feel something is wrong with the pack and want to improve it, change some colors, etc., feel free to submit an issue or do a pull request.

no-smoke-particles-and-fire:
No Smoke Particles

A lightweight Minecraft resource pack that removes all smoke particles from the game.

 

What it removes:
- Smoke from fire, torches, furnaces, and spawners
- Large smoke from blazes and fire
- Campfire and soul campfire smoke
- White smoke particles
- Ash and white ash particles (Nether biomes)

Why use it:
- Better visibility in PvP and combat
- Less visual clutter around fire and campfires
- Can help reduce lag when many smoke particles are on screen

Installation:
1. Download the pack
2. Move it to your .minecraft/resourcepacks folder
3. Enable "No Smoke Particles" in Options Resource Packs

Have you ever noticed that the enchantment glint effect shines stronger on dyed and trimmed items? This is a longstanding bug first reported in 2019 (https://mojira.dev/MC-166101) that has only gotten worse with the addition of trims and custom compound textures.

This resource pack normalizes the glint amount across normal, dyed, and trimmed items - though compound item models with more than three textures will still be brighter.

It also uses a series of pack overlays to make it so the same pack should work on every major version from 1.17 to 1.21.11.

Why was it created?

After the Armored Paws drop refreshed the look of wolf collars, cat collars were left behind, retaining an older and noticeably flatter appearance. This resource pack addresses that inconsistency by giving cat collars a modern visual update that better matches Minecraft’s current aesthetic.

 What has changed?

The updated collars are slightly wider and feature smooth color gradients, adding depth and visual charm while staying faithful to the game’s style. Each color feels more polished and intentional, helping cat companions blend naturally with the newer visuals introduced in recent updates.

 Impact on gameplay

This pack is purely visual and does not affect gameplay or mechanics in any way. It is designed to integrate seamlessly with vanilla textures, making it suitable for both survival worlds and modpacks that aim to preserve a cohesive, modern Minecraft look.

ctrvcr:
The CTR VCR shader brings the nostalgic feel of old CRT monitors and VHS tapes to your Minecraft experience, adding subtle but impactful visual artifacts and distortions. Inspired by the retro charm of analog technology, this shader introduces static noise, light distortions, chromatic aberration, scan-lines, and more to give the game a vintage, glitchy aesthetic. While these effects evoke a sense of retro realism, they are finely tuned to ensure they don't overwhelm the visuals, making the shader perfect for regular gameplay. Enjoy the blend of modern gameplay with a retro-futuristic vibe that keeps the world immersive, stylish, and entirely playable.

 

 

 Uncut gameplay using the shader (v0.0.1) in Nostalgic Craft v0.1.3o
 

---

The shader effects were originally a GLSL shader written for Unity in 2023, but were ported to minecraft shader.

Flashlight Shader
This shader makes the dark more intense in Minecraft, and gives you a tool to explore it.
 Flashlight
Torches or any light-emitting objects will act as a flashlight if held in your hand or offhand.
You can customize it's strength and color in the shader pack settings.
 Increased Darkness
If you are in a decently well lit area, you can see normally. 
If there is a small amount of light (like on the surface at night), you can see a small area around you in black and white. The size of this area depends on the phase of the moon. 
If there is no light at all, well, you won't be able to see anything.
